scope: Ten pre-existing successful fresh-migration TEST databases, public schema on PostgreSQL; metadata and flyway_schema_history only, including history table schema. No business rows, migration, repair, clean, upgrade or writes. No claim of semantic equivalence.

commands.mysql: podman exec -i <container> sh -c 'MYSQL_PWD="$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" exec mysql -uroot --batch --raw --skip-column-names "$1"' p0-readonly <allowlisted-test-db> (SQL stdin: START TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SELECT ...; ROLLBACK;)
commands.postgresql: podman exec -i <container> psql -X -U postgres -d <allowlisted-test-db> -At -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 (SQL stdin: BEGIN READ ONLY; SELECT ...; ROLLBACK;)

domains.collection: fresh read-only CLI metadata; no reused schema snapshot
